title: Single-molecule magnet behavior in an octanuclear dysprosium(III) aggregate inherited from helical triangular Dy3 SMM-building blocks

material_class.structural_family: octanuclear Dy8 cluster of two helical Dy3 triangles linked by a [Dy(μ2-CH3O)2Dy]4+ unit

synthesis.procedure: DyCl3·6H2O (0.1 mmol, 0.038 g) was added to a suspension of H3L (0.1 mmol, 0.031 g) in MeOH/MeCN (10 mL/5 mL), followed by Et3N (0.4 mmol, 0.056 mL). The resulting red solution was stirred for 4 h and filtered. The filtrate was exposed to air for slow evaporation. Dark red needles of 1 suitable for X-ray diffraction were collected after one week.
synthesis.time: stirred 4 h; crystals after one week
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction followed by filtration and slow evaporation in air
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered; filtrate exposed to air for slow solvent evaporation; dark red needles collected after one week

properties.summary: Octanuclear Dy8 cluster 1 is a zero-dc-field SMM inherited from helical Dy3 building blocks. Room-temperature χMT is 116.1 cm3 K mol−1 (expected 113.4 for eight DyIII). χMT decreases to 61.09 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K, consistent with thermal depopulation/anisotropy and possible weak antiferromagnetic exchange. Frequency-dependent ac susceptibilities appear below 12 K under zero dc field. High-T Arrhenius fit (7–10 K) gives Ueff = 18 K and τ0 = 9.74×10−6 s; a combined Orbach/direct/QTM fit over the full range gives Ueff = 28 K, τ0 = 4.95×10−6 s, A = 225.7 s−1 K−1 and τQTM = 0.4 ms. Cole–Cole α = 0.2–0.4.
